name: Screen and Recoat vs Chemical Abrasion Systems
title-tag: Screen & Recoat vs Chemical Abrasion Systems Compared
meta-description: Screen and recoat or a chemical adhesion system like TyKote? A Seattle-area contractor explains how each bonds new finish, and which floors need which.
post-summary: December 23, 2026 · Every recoat needs the new finish to grip the old — by screening it with abrasive or priming it with chemistry. We compare both preps line by line: where screens win, where aluminum-oxide factory finishes force a chemical system, and the adhesion test that matters more than either.
